stdout:
# Bounds what the tenant controller may write, independently of RBAC. Its
# RBAC can create namespaces and RoleBindings cluster-wide (it must, to create
# and enter a new workspace namespace), so without this policy it could bind
# itself into flux-system or create a namespace without Pod Security
# enforcement and run a privileged pod there. The policy matches only the
# controller's own ServiceAccount; every other actor is unaffected.
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata: {name: vuoro-tenant-controller-scope}
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
      - apiGroups: ["*"]
        apiVersions: ["*"]
        operations: [CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE]
        # '*/*' is every resource and every subresource; the API server
        # rejects it alongside any other entry.
        resources: ["*/*"]
    # kubectl's SelfSubjectAccessReview/SelfSubjectReview calls are
    # cluster-scoped virtual resources that write nothing.
    excludeResourceRules:
      - apiGroups: [authorization.k8s.io, authentication.k8s.io]
        apiVersions: ["*"]
        operations: [CREATE]
        resources: ["*"]
  matchConditions:
    - name: tenant-controller-only
      expression: request.userInfo.username == 'system:serviceaccount:vuoro-system:vuoro-tenant-controller'
  validations:
    - expression: >-
        request.resource.group == '' && request.resource.resource == 'namespaces'
        ? (request.operation != 'DELETE' && object.metadata.name.startsWith('vuoro-ws-'))
        : request.namespace.startsWith('vuoro-ws-')
      message: the tenant controller may only write inside vuoro-ws-* namespaces
      reason: Forbidden
    - expression: >-
        !(request.resource.group == '' && request.resource.resource == 'namespaces')
        || request.operation == 'DELETE'
        || (has(object.metadata.labels)
            && 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce' in object.metadata.labels
            && object.metadata.labels['pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce'] == 'restricted'
            && (!('pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version' in object.metadata.labels)
                || object.metadata.labels['pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version'] == 'latest'))
      message: workspace namespaces must enforce the restricted Pod Security level
      reason: Forbidden
    - expression: >-
        !(request.resource.group == 'rbac.authorization.k8s.io' && request.resource.resource == 'rolebindings')
        || request.operation == 'DELETE'
        || (object.roleRef.kind == 'ClusterRole'
            && object.roleRef.name == 'vuoro-tenant-workspace'
            && (!has(object.subjects) || object.subjects.all(s,
                s.kind == 'ServiceAccount' && s.name == 'vuoro-tenant-controller'
                && has(s.namespace) && s.namespace == 'vuoro-system')))
      message: the tenant controller may only bind itself to vuoro-tenant-workspace
      reason: Forbidden
    # A NodePort binds on every node address, including the operator tunnel
    # address, and a LoadBalancer or externalIPs exposes the workspace outside
    # the cluster. Workspace Services are reached only through the gateway.
    - expression: >-
        !(request.resource.group == '' && request.resource.resource == 'services')
        || request.operation == 'DELETE'
        || ((!has(object.spec.type) || object.spec.type == 'ClusterIP')
            && (!has(object.spec.externalIPs) || size(object.spec.externalIPs) == 0))
      message: the tenant controller may only create ClusterIP Services without externalIPs
      reason: Forbidden
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding
metadata: {name: vuoro-tenant-controller-scope}
spec:
  policyName: vuoro-tenant-controller-scope
  validationActions: [Deny]
